questions.question:
The bar graph given below shows the expenditure of two companies A and B in different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a06d6f1b7f22c41f8db53098a0e1325d8ca9312bad9754a2ccf8ad0ab785096d.png] 

T1 = The average expenditure of company A and B in year Y1.

T2 = The average expenditure of company A and B in year Y5.

What is the value of (T1 - T2)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

T1 = The average expenditure of company A and B in year Y1.

(800 + 2000)/2 = 1400

T2 = The average expenditure of company A and B in year Y5.

(1600 + 400)/2 = 1000

(T1 - T2)

1400 - 1000

400

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

questions.solution:
From the Bar Graph

⇒ Birth rate of country A = 20/thousand

⇒ Birth rate of country E = 36/thousand

⇒ Percentage = (birth rate of country E)/(birth rate of country A) × 100 

⇒ Percentage = (36/20) × 100 = 180%

∴ The Birth rate of country E is 180% of birth rate of country A

questions.solution:
**Calculation**

questions.question:
The import and export of a country (in lakhs rupees) during a certain period of time is given in the following bar-graph.

Read the bar-graph carefully and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f8f389fca5d4d97d3b8b14df9fafc7715aa2316fb1e5907d3014a96f8fe9cc8.png] 

During which year the difference between import and export is minimum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

**Import:**

In Year 2015-16 = 738 lakhs rupees

In Year 2016-17 = 1200 lakhs rupees

In Year 2017-18 = 1600 lakhs rupees

In Year 2018-19 = 1537 lakhs rupees

In Year 2019-20 = 1310 lakhs rupees

**Export:**

In Year 2015-16 = 825 lakhs rupees

In Year 2016-17 = 1014 lakhs rupees

In Year 2017-18 = 1240 lakhs rupees

In Year 2018-19 = 1522 lakhs rupees

In Year 2019-20 = 1650 lakhs rupees

**Calculation:**

Difference in import and export in Year 2015-16 = 825 - 738 = 87 lakhs rupees

Difference in import and export in Year 2016-17 = 1200 - 1014 = 186 lakhs rupees

Difference in import and export in Year 2017-18 = 1600 - 1240 = 360 lakhs rupees

Difference in import and export in Year 2018-19 = 1537 - 1522 = **15 lakhs rupees**

Difference in import and export in Year 2019-20 = 1650 - 1310 = 340 lakhs rupees

**∴ The difference between import and export is minimum in the year 2018-19.**

questions.question:
The following bar graph describes the population of a town (in lakhs) from 2001 to 2007.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3f2768c130d5d7e867038d5a1c2c7e8cdac1a84e84dda3396d67582982a15cc.png] 

Find the percentage increase in population from 2006 to 2007.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Population in 2006 = 9.5 lakhs

⇒ Population in 2007 = 11.4 lakhs

⇒ Increase in population from 2006 to 2007 = 11.4 – 9.5 = 1.9

⇒ Percentage increase in population from 2006 to 2007 = (1.9)/(9.5) × 100 = (100)/(5) = 20%

**Therefore, the percentage increase in population from 2006 to 2007 is 20%.**

questions.solution:
**Given:**

There is a histogram that shows the marks obtained by students in an examination

**Calculation:**

The number of students who obtained less than 200 marks = 30

The number of students who obtained 400 or more marks = 35

= (5/35) × 100

= 14.285...%

**∴ The number of students who obtained less than 200 marks is 14.3% less than the number of students who obtained 400 or more marks**

What is the ratio of the number of students in the science stream of schools A, B, and D taken together to the number of students of the vocational stream in schools B, D, and E has taken together?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcdcdfca70f5171e6ca21f138dd6e1b23fbd711df687ee220aa4cf4e62b288f4.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total students in science stream from school A, B, and D = 60 + 78 + 40

⇒ 178

Total students in vocational stream from school B, D, and E = 40 + 40 + 50

⇒ 130

Ratio = 178 : 130

⇒ 89 : 65

**∴ Required ratio is 89 : 65**

questions.question:
Study the following graph and answer the question the follows.

Marks scored by five students A, B, C, D and E in three subjects (Maths, English and Physics). Total marks for each subject are 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8faa1f5b2966eca3791cae55b83286621a1a2011fe80f720a06ec93e0dac4fc8.png] 

What is the percentage marks obtained by E in all three subjects together? (Assuming maximum marks for each subject are 100.)
questions.solution:
**Calculations :**

Marks of E in Maths = 60

Marks of E in English = 50

Marks of E in Physics = 70 

Total marks of E = 60 + 50 + 70 = 180

Percentage marks of E = (Marks obtained/Total marks) × 100

⇒ (180/300) × 100

⇒ 60

**∴**** The Correct choice will be option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Since the maximum marks is 100. We can say marks obtained is the percentage obtained.

Average percentage is 60% as 50, 60 and 70 are in A.P and the number of terms is odd. Then the average will be the middle term which is 60.

**∴ The average is 60%.**

questions.question:
The given graph represents the rainfall (in cm) in a city, over a period of six years. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeb2fdb68201f9c2cfb4270f0119e5474a07ede9db2197ebd5c47e042c73b3be.png] 

In which two consecutive years was the difference of the rainfall minimum?
questions.solution:
**Given :-**

In year 2005 rainfall = 40 cm

In year 2006 rainfall = 50 cm

In year 2007 rainfall = 100 cm

In year 2008 rainfall = 80 cm 

In year 2009 rainfall = 20 cm

In year 2010 rainfall = 120 cm

**Calculation :- **

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2005 and 2006 = 50 - 40 = 10 cm

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2006 and 2007 = 100 - 50 = 50 cm

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2007 and 2008 = 100 - 80 = 20 cm

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2008 and 2009 = 80 - 20 = 60 cm

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2009 and 2010 = 120 - 20 = 100 cm

⇒ The difference of the rainfall minimum = 10 cm 

⇒ The two consecutive years = 2005 - 2006

**∴ The two consecutive years the difference of the rainfall minimum is 2005 - 2006**

questions.question:
Study the following graph and answer the question based on the graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f0c46be74573c7ad20209fcd5a868c81ae3a93d3381199940812e8e9fe65c85.png] 

What was the percentage decline in the production from Friday to Saturday?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Units produced on Friday = 50

Units produced on Friday = 30

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Decline = ((a – b)/a) × 100

**Calculations:**

Units produced on Friday = 50

Units produced on Friday = 30

Percentage Decline = ((a – b)/a) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = ((50 – 30)/50) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = (20/50) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = 40%

**∴ The percentage decline in the production from Friday to Saturday is 40%.**

questions.question:
Study the given bar-chart and answer the question that follows.

The bar-chart shows the production of maize by a state (in 1000 tonnes) over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af89b3fd70d453b4f39514a1f87b93901e5c3b336a89b9a868fcd1a5e55abbde.png] 

What was the percentage increase in the production of maize in 2019 compared to that in 2017?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

Old Value (2017) = 20 (in 1000 tonnes)

New Value (2019) = 65 (in 1000 tonnes) 

**Formula used:-**

Percentage Increase = [(New Value - Old Value) / Old Value] × 100%

**Calculation:- **

Percentage Increase = [(65 - 20) / 20] × 100%

Percentage Increase = (45 / 20) × 100% = 225%

**∴ The production of maize in 2019 increased by__ 225%__ compared to that in 2017. **

questions.question:
In the given bar graph, the first bar shows the income and the second bar shows the expenditure of a company. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac136a80b56d598338dc4b0dc8c1b7c75664871b862ab783a9b93ca70d4698cc.png] 

The expenditure from 2001 to 2002 is decreased by what percentage?
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

Percentage decrease = (x₁ - x₂)/x₁ × 100

x1 → Original number 

x2 → New number 

**Calculation:**

Expenditure in 2001 = 20 lakhs

Expenditure in 2002 = 15 lakhs

Decrement = 20 - 15 = 5 lakhs

**∴ Required percentage = (5/20) × 100 = 25%**
